label: Figure 2.1: An early supply and demand diagram (Marshall)
alt: A supply and demand diagram with a downward-sloping demand curve DD', an upward-sloping supply curve SS' meeting at point A, and shaded regions labelled consumer's rent, producer's rent and producer's expenses.
caption: A redrawn version of Marshall’s supply and demand diagram. The demand curve DD′ slopes down and the supply curve SS′ slopes up, meeting at A, which fixes the equilibrium price F and quantity H. Above the price line and below demand is consumer’s rent (consumer surplus); between the price line and supply is producer’s rent; below supply are producer’s expenses. At quantity M, Q is the price the marginal buyer would pay and P the price the marginal seller would accept.
